label: GO WITH CONDITIONS
recommendation: Run a 90-day pilot of one channel under the 'science and history, told as stories' umbrella, with 'what if' as the labelled lead. Five long videos, 4 hours a week, a paid Odoo offer on every video. Stop at day 90 with no second vote if no qualified Odoo inquiry comes from the channel.
conditions: Kill criteria written in a dated file before the first upload
Two-week hour log started, with the Odoo billing rate written at the top; raise the rate first if it is under $30 an hour
Named list of 100 people who would be upset if the channel stopped, by day 14; fewer than 30 means stop
Odoo billing stays within 10% of the three-month baseline through day 90
Channel hours capped at 4 a week; more than 4 for three straight weeks pauses the channel
Every factual claim has a named primary source and a second check before upload
$150 cash cap across 90 days; tool spend under $50 a month
next_steps: This week: write the kill criteria, start the two-week hour log, write the Odoo billing rate at the top of the log
By day 14: name the 100 people, check the hour log against the 10-hour first-video estimate; cut to two videos if the first video runs over 10 hours
By day 45: check Odoo billing against the baseline; pause if down more than 10%
By day 60: read views, retention and offers by format; switch the lead to history if two videos are under 1,000 views each
By day 90: continue only if at least one qualified Odoo inquiry came from the channel
cheapest_test: The two-week hour log, then one long video with a paid Odoo link. Under $150 and about 20 founder hours.
kill_criteria: Day 90: no qualified Odoo inquiry from the channel, or Odoo billing down more than 10% from baseline. Either one ends the channel.
